{
  "name": "tape",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "A ticker tape above the prompt: live stock, index, gold, FX and crypto prices, keyless by default.",
  "homepage": "https://modmyclaude.com/mods/tape",
  "repository": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/tree/main/mods/tape#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/terms",
  "author": {
    "name": "modmyclaude"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "stocks",
    "crypto",
    "ticker",
    "prices",
    "band",
    "hyperliquid",
    "alpaca"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "On",
      "description": "Off draws nothing, runs no timer and fetches nothing.",
      "default": true
    },
    "symbols": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Symbols",
      "description": "Comma-separated. Stocks, indices, gold and FX as Hyperliquid lists them (AAPL, SP500, GOLD, EUR), crypto by name (BTC, ETH). Forty at most.",
      "default": "AAPL,NVDA,TSLA,AMZN,SP500,GOLD,BTC,ETH"
    },
    "refresh": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Refresh (seconds)",
      "description": "How often prices are fetched. At least 5; after a failure the wait doubles, up to five minutes, until the next success.",
      "default": 10,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 300
    },
    "motion": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Motion",
      "description": "scroll: a marquee moving a few cells a second, the pace in the speed setting; every step redraws the band, about 5% of a core at the default pace. rotate: pages of whole symbols that fit the band, flipped every few seconds, one redraw a page, close to free.",
      "default": "scroll",
      "options": [
        "scroll",
        "rotate"
      ]
    },
    "speed": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Scroll speed (cells per second)",
      "description": "How far the marquee moves each second when motion is scroll. Four reads at a glance; ten is the engine's ceiling for redraws.",
      "default": 4,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 10
    },
    "rotateSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Rotate every (seconds)",
      "description": "How long each page shows when motion is rotate.",
      "default": 8,
      "min": 2,
      "max": 60
    },
    "alpacaKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Alpaca key id (optional)",
      "description": "With the secret below, stock symbols come as real-time IEX quotes from data.alpaca.markets under your own Alpaca account; crypto stays on Hyperliquid. Stored as a secret, never drawn or logged.",
      "sensitive": true
    },
    "alpacaSecret": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Alpaca secret key (optional)",
      "description": "The secret that goes with the key id above. Stored as a secret, never drawn or logged.",
      "sensitive": true
    }
  }
}
